name: lazyspec
description: Let the agent experiment, then write the requirement. Specifications are locked, so an agent can never rewrite your requirements to match what it built.
//hooks: Registered by installing the plugin, so nobody edits settings.json by hand. The guard is read from the plugin, not the project - a project needing its own LOCKED pattern copies lazyspec-guard into itself and registers it in .claude/settings.json instead.
